title: VisionOcrRequest
description: vision.ocr-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/ocr. The local Tesseract 5 reader runs on Vision's host and costs nothing; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass found no usable text, which needs a signed-in person or a service token holding vision.ocr.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
